newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter Discover sets 2-for-1 split.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter Discover sets 2-for-1 split.

text.p: Dean Witter Discover & Co. Monday announced a two-for-one stock split, payable Jan. 14 to stockholders of record as of Dec. 26.

The Wall Street firm also raised its quarterly dividend to 14 cents per share on the split-adjusted stock from 11 cents, payable April 1 to stockholders of record as of March 3. The company had been paying 22 cents per share on the pre-split shares.
Dean Witter's stock fell 12.5 cents to $64.50 on the New York Stock Exchange.
